source.notes: Scanned school paper with no text layer; OCR corrected against the page images. The paper prints "Final Term Examination 2017-2018"; examYear 2018 is the later year of that session. It is a single Science paper (Full Marks : 80, Time : 2hrs.+15mins.) with Physics, Chemistry and Biology items mixed within Section - A and Section - B (no subject sections); this pack holds the items judged to be Physics (8 items, 13 of the 80 marks), so maxMarks is left null. Question numbers restart in Section - B and are prefixed "B" here. Section - A Q2 prints [5x1=5] but only three items appear. The flower figure for Section - B Q4 is missing from the file. The icseboard.org watermark is ignored. Simple machines/levers have no class-6 physics chapter in the taxonomy; mapped to "force" as the nearest related chapter (editors to confirm).
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
